detail.longDescription: Meta has shifted to a new family of flagship AI models called Muse and sent the Llama "herd" of models to the farm upstate. It's an understandable shift in AI strategy from the company that was once pioneering open models. The newest models are Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, and Muse Ember. Wonder and Spark are Meta's first real attempt at top-tier frontier models, while Ember is a small, low-cost model for high-volume agent work.
